title: Omwoyo Emabega w'Ekifaananyi
intro: Mu kisiikirize ky’okusenguka okunene okuva mu bufuzi obw’ekibogwe, omuntu ono ow’ekyama yali alinze mu ddungu. Omukulembeze w’abantu abalonde bwe yali alinnya olusozi olutukuvu olw’okussa ekimu okw’obwakatonda, okugezesebwa okunene kwakka ku abo abaalekebwa emabega. Ono ssekinnoomu yakwata akaseera ako okuddamu okukola enzikiriza z’ekitundu kyonna. Omukulembeze bwe yakomawo n’amazima, ekibonerezo eky’enjawulo era eky’olubeerera kyalagirwa. Osobola okuzuula emmeeme eno eyali eriko enkaayana era ey’obukuusa yali ani?
clues: Natambula n’abantu abaali basumuluddwa okuva mu mikono gy’omunyigiriza ow’amaanyi nga mpita mu bubonero obw’ekyamagero.
Omukulembeze waabwe bwe yalinnya ku lusozi okufuna obulagirizi, nnalinda mu abo abaali basigadde emabega.
Nakung’aanya ebyuma eby’omuwendo okuva mu by’okwewunda byabwe ne mbikola ekintu ekivaamu eddoboozi.
Okuyita mu kitonde kino, nnamatiza omulembe gwonna nti baali bazudde katonda waabwe mu ddungu.
Omukulembeze bwe yakomawo, nnalonda ne bambuuza ekyandeetera okulimba ng’okwo.
Ekibonerezo kyange mu nsi muno kyali nti tewali muntu yenna yandinkwatako wadde okunsemberera, akabonero k’ensonyi ke ngumira emirembe gyonna.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
